correctness.rationale: Geometric smoothness equals invertibility of the symmetric polar-gradient matrix, valid over the algebraic closure in char 3. Unique RREF enumeration over all 11011 dimension-two and 33880 dimension-three subspaces yields 1872 and 288 smooth spaces; direct membership mapping finds two net extensions per pencil. A separate quotient-space procedure tests exactly 40 extensions of an explicit pencil and finds two, while four explicit coordinate generators exhaust GL3(3) and give a transitive 1872-pencil orbit and disjoint 144-net orbits. The two standalone Python files were executed; finite exhaustive enumeration is the proof, not sampling.

value.rationale: The exact universal extension multiplicity is a natural nontrivial finite-geometric incidence question: every smooth pencil has two and exactly two different smooth containing nets, separated by distinct projective types. The complete biregular incidence is not implied by conic or pencil total counts, and the result gives a sharp field-specific contrast with characteristic-two unique extension.
